h1: Scale Philippine Work with 24/7 Autonomous AI Agents
sub: Empower your agency, BPO operations, or remote career across Metro Manila and Cebu with personal AI agents that research, code, and execute tasks around the clock.
audience: BPO leaders, virtual assistants, software developers, marketing agencies, and remote Filipino professionals managing international client operations across time zones.
manifesto: Whether bridging shifts between Manila and Western time zones or scaling high-volume digital workflows, Ceyo gives every Filipino professional an autonomous, private cloud teammate that works tirelessly 24/7 even while your laptop is closed.

uses.d: Manage round-the-clock US and European client inquiries in Telegram and Gmail with automated triage, draft replies, and Sheets logging.
Direct your agent's browser to compare supplier quotes, scan regional e-commerce stores, and extract structured catalog data automatically.
Let coding agents write, debug, and test modern web apps inside an isolated cloud computer without slowing down your personal machine.
Integrate 1,000+ workplace tools to route lead inquiries from website forms straight into your CRM, Slack channels, and calendars.
Deploy voice-enabled agents to handle call follow-ups, interview pre-screenings, and routine appointment updates with natural conversational pacing.
Harness long-term memory to analyze cross-client documentation and generate thorough, audit-ready briefing decks on schedule.

steps.d: Assign specialized roles and connect Telegram, email accounts, and your favorite cloud workspaces.
Schedule browser tasks, code executions, or recurring summaries inside your bot's dedicated cloud computer.
Track progress from your phone or group chats while your agents continue executing independently around the clock.

chapters.d: Your day starts with a consolidated Telegram update prepared by your research bot reviewing overnight client requests from the US. Spreadsheets and Notion boards are already updated with prioritized next steps.

While you break for lunch in BGC, your agent's cloud browser navigates vendor directories to extract product pricing tables. It cleans the raw data into an executive summary ready for immediate client review.

Your coding agent builds, tests, and validates an internal dashboard within its sandboxed virtual environment. It diagnoses runtime bugs autonomously without consuming your laptop's memory or battery.
As you disconnect for the evening, your bot team maintains active watch over incoming emails and automated background tasks. Their dedicated cloud computers run continuously 24/7 until the morning.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo plans are Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial featuring up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, with your linked card billed only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Can Ceyo agents understand Filipino and Taglish?
faq.a: Yes, Ceyo agents effortlessly process English, Filipino (Tagalog), and mixed Taglish phrasing. They understand local colloquial context and adapt tone for local colleagues or foreign client communication.

faq.q: How does the cloud computer keep running when my device is off?
faq.a: Every bot operates on its own dedicated virtual cloud computer rather than your personal phone or PC. Even during power fluctuations or Wi-Fi interruptions, your scheduled automations and browser jobs run non-stop.

faq.q: Can I use Ceyo agents directly inside Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, you can create private Telegram bots or introduce multiple Ceyo agents into group chats. They coordinate as an agile team of specialists to answer questions, write code, or automate workflows natively in chat.

faq.q: Is my proprietary data and workspace secure?
faq.a: Your agents run inside sandboxed, isolated cloud environments with encrypted storage and strict access perimeters. Your connected apps, documents, and memory remain completely private to your account.
